title: My Mexican Beef
description: Shaved steak is simmered with tomatoes, chipotle peppers, and cinnamon in this Mexican-inspired beef you can serve over rice or tortillas.
ingredients: 1 (4 ounce) can chopped green chile peppers
1 tablespoon chopped chipotle peppers, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.25 cup chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir until softened, about 3 minutes. Stir in garlic; cook until tender, about 1 minute. Stir in tomatoes, green chile peppers, and chipotle peppers. Bring to a simmer.

Stir shaved steak, cumin, coriander, salt, pepper, and cinnamon stick into the saucepan. Bring back to a simmer, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and cover; cook, stirring occasionally, until steak is very tender, about 1 hour.
Discard cinnamon stick and stir cilantro into the saucepan.
